CHECK BURST CS-check-01 — assemble and measure the cliffside FIRST PORTION (proof step, Matt R-C3-43/44). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-check-01".

Inputs (read-only): painted chunks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-chunk-A/chunk_A.png and /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-chunk-B/chunk_B.png (1536×1024; flat #00ff00 = void); blockout masks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides/chunk_A_mask.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides/chunk_B_mask.png (255 = foreground); /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides/chunks.json (A origin (700,2250), B origin (1980,2250) → B sits 1280 px right of A; overlap 256 px; Keeper spawn in B at (306.0,157.4); a 1.75 m figure = 130 px); /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides/shadow_ellipse.png (58×47, alpha shadow); background /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-vista-01/vista_01.png (1536×1024); Keeper frames /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells/idle_S/frames/idle/S/idle_S_00.png and /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells/walk_E/frames/walk/E/walk_E_03.png (512 RGBA). Frozen tool: /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract with edge_mode='clamp'). python glue with PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files.

STEP 1 — alpha: for each chunk, painted_alpha = gates.matte.extract(chunk, edge_mode='clamp') alpha. Final alpha = painted_alpha restricted to (blockout mask dilated by 6 px) — the geometry decides where foreground may exist, the painting's own key decides the exact rim within 6 px. Write out/chunk_A_rgba.png, out/chunk_B_rgba.png.
STEP 2 — fidelity (numbers into out/checks.json): per chunk: IoU(painted_alpha ≥ 128, mask ≥ 128); fraction of mask-foreground pixels the painting left green (hole fraction); fraction of painting pixels outside the mask dilated by 6 px (spill fraction); mean and 95th-percentile distance (px) from each painted-alpha boundary pixel to the nearest mask boundary pixel. Also a seam metric: over the overlap (A x 1280–1535 vs B x 0–255, where both are foreground) the mean absolute RGB difference and its median by row band; write out/seam_overlap_A_B_x4.png = the two 256 px strips side by side plus |diff|×4.
STEP 3 — assemble: canvas W = 1280+1536 = 2816, H = 1024. Background: the vista scaled uniformly (LANCZOS) to cover 2816×1024 (crop the excess centred; note the scale). Foreground: A at x=0, B at x=1280; in the 256-px overlap blend A→B with a linear horizontal alpha ramp (only where both have alpha). Characters: crop each Keeper frame to its alpha≥128 bbox and scale uniformly to 130 px tall; the idle Keeper's feet (bottom-centre) at B spawn → canvas (1280+306, 157); the walk frame 90 px to its right on the same ground line; under each, the shadow ellipse centred on the feet, drawn before the character. Write out/portion_composite_2816x1024.png and out/portion_composite_noKeeper.png.
STEP 4 — the player's screen: out/screen_view_1920x1080.png = a 1920×1080 frame whose pixel (962,595) is the idle Keeper's feet point (the game camera's anchor); where the frame extends beyond the assembled canvas, fill with the scaled vista continued (tile/mirror the vista is NOT allowed — extend the canvas height by scaling the vista to cover the full needed area instead). Also out/screen_view_960x540.png downscaled.
STEP 5 — out/review.html (self-contained, relative paths): the screen view first, then the full composite, the no-Keeper composite, the two RGBA chunks on a checkerboard, the seam strip, and the fidelity table with one-line definitions. out/summary.txt ≤ 12 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 13 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-check-01"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
